title: Development and Validation of a Deep Learning System for the Detection of Nondisplaced Femoral Neck Fractures
summary: A deep-learning radiograph system detected nondisplaced femoral-neck fractures with internal, physician-comparison, and external validation cohorts. This supports diagnostic performance, not a patient-outcome benefit.
organization: Department of Orthopedics, The First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University, School of Medicine, Xiamen University, Xiamen 361003, China

evidence.tested: A deep-learning radiograph system detected nondisplaced femoral-neck fractures with internal, physician-comparison, and external validation cohorts. This supports diagnostic performance, not a patient-outcome benefit.
evidence.unknown: The study does not establish improved patient outcomes or generalization beyond the evaluated setting.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
